hook: Give it a model repo, get a running server.
hookText: lmdeck runs local LLMs for you

beats.say: lmdeck is a Rust command-line tool and dashboard for managing local LLM serving recipes.
Give it a model repo and it detects how to run it, writes the recipe, and checks whether it fits your hardware, from Macs to one or more DGX Sparks.
Then it pulls the weights, launches the server, and hands it straight to your agent harness, with no manual setup in between.
